# Rye Lane Bakery — wholesale rate card, June 2026

Effective 2026-06-01. Ex-VAT, per loaf.

- Sourdough, 800 g — £3.10
- Tin loaf, 800 g, white or wholemeal — £2.40
- Seeded batch, 600 g — £2.85 (minimum 10 per drop)

Volume: 12 % off the whole order above 120 loaves per week, applied at invoice.
One tier. No other discounts.

Programme terms: 40 loaves/week minimum, delivery by 06:30 within 6 km, four
weeks' notice to change standing volume. No sale-or-return, no own-label, no
area exclusivity.

Note from the owner, 2026-05-28: the mill has notified a 9 % flour cost rise.
Not passed through yet. Do not quote a new price until the card is reissued.
